Calm Under Fire.name: Calm Under Fire
Calm Under Fire.description:
🧊 When things go wrong, you get quieter and clearer.

🌱 In danger you slow down: a level voice, short sentences and eyes on what matters.
🧠 Panic and threats have a hard time taking your focus.
⚠️ The fear waits until the crisis is over, then returns: a sleepless night, shaking hands, a short temper or numbness.
⚠️ Others can read your calm as coldness, especially at a hospital bed or a funeral.
🔀 If you are also Hot-Blooded, you flare up over small things in daily life and go quiet in real danger.

📈 Grants: Willpower +5
Calm Under Fire.traitNarrativeEffects: In danger the character slows down: a level voice, short sentences, eyes on what matters. Panicking civilians and nervous teammates settle around them, and threats get less grip on them. Weakness: the calm has a cost. They push fear and grief down during the crisis and it returns afterward, once everyone is safe: a sleepless night, shaking hands, a short temper or numbness. Others can read the calm as coldness, especially at a hospital bed or a funeral. If the character is also Hot-Blooded, they flare up over small things in daily life and go quiet in real danger. The narrator shows the aftershock; how the character handles it, and who gets to see it, is up to the player.
